title: In Japan, locals witnessed an unusual sight on May 11: nine pillars o...
description: In Japan, locals witnessed an unusual sight on May 11: nine pillars of light appearing in the night sky above the ocean. These beams of light, seen near the small fishing town of Daisen, prompted speculation about their origin, including theories of alien activity.  However, the phenomenon, known as 'Isaribi Kochu', has a reasonable explanation. The lights are actually reflections from off-shore fishing vessels, refracted into the clouds. This rare event is seen only once every few years when the air conditions allow ice crystals to form in the sky. #japan #science #sciencenews #news
